fullContentHtml:
SSC CGL Exam City Details 2026 – Full Details

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the exam city details for the post of Combined Graduate Level CGL Examination 2026. This recruitment was released for 12256 posts. Applications for the SSC CGL Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 21 May 2026, to 25 August 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 30 September 2026 – 30 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can check their SSC CGL Exam City Details 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 May 2026
  • Last Date : 25 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 June 2026
  • Correction Date : 01-03 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 30 September 2026 – 30 October 2026
  • Exam City Details : 22 September 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-
  • Correction Charges :
  • First Time : Rs. 200/-
  • Second Time : Rs. 500/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
